description: "Makes Tinkers' Construct tools compatible with vanilla enchantments, adds two workstations for applying and upgrading enchantments on Tinkers' tools, and allows you to freely configure various values—including Tinkers' vanilla mechanics like the annoying damage decay."

releases.notes:
Mattock Enhancement

Turned the mattock into a true multi-purpose tool (combining axe, shovel, and hoe functions)

Ranged Weapon Improvements

Bows and crossbows are now compatible with the "Strafe" enchantment

Removed draw delay; rapid shooting no longer fails to fire arrows

Compatibility Fix

Fixed an issue where enabling "Disable Damage Cutoff" together with Tinkers' Evolution mod would prevent damage from being dealt



鹤嘴锄增强

使鹤嘴锄成为真正的多功能工具（斧、铲、锄三合一）

远程武器优化

弓和弩现在兼容"扫射"附魔

移除了拉弓延迟，高速拉弓不会再射不出箭

兼容性修复

修复了与匠魂进化模组同时安装时，开启"祛除伤害衰减"选项导致无法造成伤害的问题
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FoxInkShiba/Tinkers_Enchantment_-_Modification/compare/v1.1...v1.3

Armor Reduction System (Completely Rewritten)

Three independent configuration groups: Tinkers' Armor, Modded/Vanilla Armor, Non-Player Entities

Custom damage reduction formula support (K value, damage decay, single-piece immunity threshold, JS expressions)

Configurable option to make armor reduce all types of damage (physical, magic, void, explosion, etc.), including hostile mobs

Performance Optimization

Optimized Tinkers' damage decay calculation to reduce performance cost

Configurable damage reduction caps for each Tinkers' armor piece and overall armor in the config file

护甲减伤系统（完全重写）

 支持三种独立配置：匠魂盔甲、模组/原版盔甲、非玩家生物

 支持自定义减伤公式（K值、伤害衰减、单件免伤阈值、JS表达式）

可配置让护甲减免所有类型伤害（物理、魔法、虚空、爆炸等），包括敌对生物

性能优化

优化匠魂伤害衰减计算，减少性能消耗

使配置文件可以配置匠魂各部位减伤上限和盔甲减伤上限

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FoxInkShiba/Tinkers_Enchantment_-_Modification/compare/v1.1...v1.2

Additions:
- Battle signs can now properly use shield-specific enchantments (such as Instinct Defense from So Many Enchantments, etc.)
- Advanced Enchanting Table now features a material enchantment system, allowing various materials to upgrade corresponding enchantments
- Added global materials (Dragon Egg) to grant all enchantments at level 1
- Changed enchantment boost item from diamond to diamond block

Configuration:
- Added enchantment_materials.json configuration file for custom material enchantments
- Default support: Sharpness(Quartz), Efficiency(Redstone), Fortune/Looting(Lapis Lazuli), Unbreaking(Obsidian), Protection(Iron Block), Power(String), Mending(Experience Bottle)

新增：
- 战斗牌子现在可以正常使用盾牌专属附魔（如更多附魔的本能防卫等）
- 附魔锻造台新增材料附魔系统，支持多种材料升级对应附魔
- 新增全局材料（龙蛋）可获得所有附魔1级
- 附魔升级物品改为钻石块（原为钻石）

配置：
- 新增 enchantment_materials.json 配置文件，可自定义材料附魔
- 默认支持：锋利(石英)、效率(红石)、时运/抢夺(青金石)、耐久(黑曜石)、保护(铁块)、力量(线)、经验修补(经验瓶)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FoxInkShiba/Tinkers_Enchantment_-_Modification/compare/v1.0...v1.1
